_comment: One entry per camera view. id: also its node in the exit graph (app/exit_router.py) unless graph_node is set.
source: rtsp:// URL or a video file path relative to the repo root. rtsp://localhost:8554/<name> is the clip
data/india_dataset/raw_videos/<name>.mp4: read directly with FRAME_SOURCE=local (default, no Docker) or
replayed by MediaMTX with FRAME_SOURCE=redis. Clip sources are listed in data/india_dataset/sources.csv.
roi: walkable-area polygon in camera pixels [[x, y], ...]; null = whole frame.
Persons/m2 needs either area_m2 (rough ground area of the ROI) or calibration:
{"image_points": [[x, y] x4+], "ground_points": [[X_m, Y_m] x4+]} from measured floor markers (plan 4.5).
fixed_camera: true for a camera that never moves (pole-mounted CCTV): its whole-frame motion is then never
removed as 'camera motion', even when a dense procession fills the view. Default false (auto-detect).
The demo clips are 2025 Prayagraj Maha Kumbh news footage standing in for Nashik cameras. Their area_m2
values are rough visual estimates, not measurements (3000 m2 is what was used for the aerial clip in the
video analysis runs), so the persons/m2 and risk levels they give are illustrative only.
